## Body

From the prime silkworm, 2026-11-10 20:40, relaying another project's PA (stoat, pm-004's fleet): two coders at ~644k and ~575k had compacts parked as 'unrecognized'. Background Copilot sub-agents kept the composer busy, and MallocStackLogging lines written to the tty broke the pane parse. That matches spoonbill's three drops here. Workaround: send --command compact only when the seat is idle AND no background agent is running. The pane footer line says 'Waiting for background agents' or '← N agent' when one is. If one is running, wait for the seat's next idle, or ask it to finish or stop its agents first. Also, when checking that a seat's memory note exists, look back to the request time, not just 15 minutes: I missed starfish's 19:06 note that way.
